title: Music Copyright Infringement Resource (GW Law and Columbia Law)
why: Case pages with the opinions, audio and procedural history for US music copyright cases; free.

title: US Copyright Office, Circular 56A
why: The official statement of the two copyrights in every recording, in eight plain pages.

title: US Copyright Office, Music Modernization Act FAQ
why: What the section 115 license covers and how pre-1972 recordings are now protected.

title: European IP Helpdesk (European Commission)
why: Plain summaries of CJEU rulings, including Pelham II, with links to the judgments.

title: Musicologize, Case Law Library
why: A musicologist's running index of US music copyright decisions, with notes on where the circuit split stands.

title: Kembrew McLeod and Peter DiCola, Creative License: The Law and Culture of Digital Sampling (Duke University Press, 2011)
why: The standard book on sampling law and culture, built on interviews with producers, lawyers and clearance agents; this is a hosted excerpt.

title: Complete Music Update
why: UK trade coverage that follows sampling disputes closely and separates what is confirmed from what is claimed.
